changes: Wrapped the four top-level install stages (Python NLP tools, Sherlock, Ferret check, WCopyfind check) into named functions and moved each into its own lib/plagiarism_*.sh sibling, sourced by the entry script -- matching the existing install_exercism.sh + lib/exercism_config.sh convention in the same directory.

Extracted the two embedded Python heredocs into real .py files (check_plagiarism.py, sherlock.py) installed via `install -m` instead of `cat <<EOF`, matching download_nltk_data.py's prior extraction in the same directory. check_plagiarism.py then needed a second split (into plagiarism_similarity.py) to also clear 250 lines, since the file-length gate covers .py.

Made both nltk/sklearn (check_plagiarism.py/plagiarism_similarity.py) and PyPDF2/python-docx (conditionally, inside read_file) dynamic imports via importlib.import_module, so the modules stay importable and lintable (ruff/mypy/pylint clean) in this repo's environment, which deliberately does not have the plagiarism toolchain's runtime deps installed.

Converted every print() call in check_plagiarism.py/sherlock.py to sys.stdout.write() to satisfy this repo's T201 ruff rule (select=ALL), after asking the user to confirm that approach over adding a per-file-ignore -- per code-quality.md, per-file-ignores need explicit sign-off every time.

Fixed install_sherlock's use of a global $SCRIPT_DIR it was never passed: writing a harness test caught that the fallback-copy path silently failed to find sherlock.py when called with only $INSTALL_DIR in scope. Changed it to take script_dir as an explicit $1, matching install_python_nlp_tools' existing signature.

Fixed lib/plagiarism_python.sh installing check_plagiarism.py without its new plagiarism_similarity.py dependency: caught by testing the installed output, not by inspection. Now both files are installed together.

Wrote a PATH-shim test harness (fake python3/pip/git/java/wine) so every lib function and the entry script's main()/print_summary() run for real against recorded fakes rather than being mocked at the call-site level, per the user's explicit preference for this test seam.

Committed the pre-existing unrelated CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md symlink rename and .gitignore update (cocoindex_code) as a separate first commit, per explicit user instruction to land tracked dirty files but leave untracked ones alone.
